answer: Attackers forging many identities must fund every bond and sustain each fake history past a rolling horizon of audits, so the cost scales linearly with sock-puppet count while honest participants pay once. Duplicate or unverifiable relics get slashed, making mass reputation slot creation economically irrational. In practice, qwe0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
